q: In 2026, artificial intelligence AI already creates texts, images, videos, and music. It helps write code, detect diseases in images, and answer questions. Neural networks are trained on a huge number of examples from the internet and learn to find patterns. If a neural network is trained on a large amount of data, does it mean it will always correctly understand a new situation?
o: Yes, a large amount of data guarantees the correct answer
No, because training on data does not guarantee a correct solution in a new situation
Yes, if it has more data than a human
ok: Correct. Even large amounts of data do not guarantee correct understanding of a new situation. AI works based on probabilities.
bad: Even if there is a lot of data, new situations may differ from the examples. AI makes conclusions based on similarity and probability, so it can make mistakes.

q: In 2026, AI can create images based on a text description. If you ask a neural network to «draw a flying cat in space», it will generate an image even though such a cat does not exist. What does this mean?
o: The neural network has seen a real flying cat
The neural network imagines like a human
The neural network combines data it already knows
The neural network invents everything randomly
ok: Excellent. The neural network does not «see the world» like a human — it combines learned patterns and examples.
bad: The neural network does not «see the world» like a human. It builds results from learned patterns and combinations, which is why it can create things that do not exist in reality.
